config.selection: strictly lower validation total integer cost; ties retain parent, otherwise earliest submitted child
config.allocation: one immutable root stem; up to three copies allocated to positive paired validation benefits, initially one each then remaining to greatest benefit (quiet wins equal benefits)
config.causal_pairing: Within each seed/split, both demand branches have identical targets, urgency and initial_x; only integer cost weights differ.
config.scope: Exploratory controller differentiation; every policy step uses exact integer arithmetic; no natural-world safety claim.
